content:
Apple Upgrade is a brand new rental plan announced today, allowing you to obtain Apple products through a low monthly fee subscription. Below are the prices for each eligible product under the Apple Upgrade program.

iPhone

Below are the current monthly fees for each iPhone model on the 24-month Apple Upgrade rental plan:

  • iPhone 17 Pro: $31.99 per month
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max: $34.99 per month
  • iPhone Air: $28.99 per month
  • iPhone 17: $22.99 per month
  • iPhone 17e: $17.99 per month

The above are all base model prices. Choosing a higher storage capacity version only requires a slight additional cost.

If you prefer a shorter 12-month rental plan, Apple also offers that, but the monthly fee will be correspondingly higher.

iPad

Below are the prices for iPad on the 36-month Apple Upgrade rental plan:

  • 11-inch iPad Air: $15.99 per month
  • 13-inch iPad Air: $19.99 per month
  • 11-inch iPad Pro: $24.99 per month
  • 13-inch iPad Pro: $30.99 per month
  • iPad mini: $11.99 per month

Similarly, the above are base model prices; upgrading the specifications will slightly increase the monthly fee. If you want to shorten the rental term, you can choose the 24-month plan, but the monthly fee will be higher.

Mac

Below are the Apple prices for Mac on the 36-month Apple Upgrade rental plan:

  • 13-inch MacBook Air: $24.99 per month
  • 15-inch MacBook Air: $28.99 per month
  • 14-inch MacBook Pro: $38.99 per month
  • 16-inch MacBook Pro: $57.99 per month
  • iMac: $28.99 per month
  • Mac Studio: $48.99 per month

Upgraded models with options for additional memory, storage, or other configurations will increase the monthly fee.

Apple Watch

Below are the prices for Apple Watch on the 24-month Apple Upgrade rental plan:

  • Apple Watch Series 11 (42mm): $11.99 per month
  • Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm): $12.85 per month
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3: $24.99 per month

You can also choose the 12-month Apple Watch rental plan, but the monthly fee will be adjusted accordingly.

Complete information about Apple Upgrade is available on Apple's official website.

Would you use Apple Upgrade to purchase your future Apple products? What are your reasons? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
